analysis: Enzymatic markers of the plasma membrane typically include enzymes that are integral to the membrane structure and function. 5'-nucleotidase, Na+-K+-ATPase, and Galactosyl transferase are all known to be associated with the plasma membrane. However, Adenylyl cyclase is primarily located on the inner side of the plasma membrane and is involved in intracellular signaling rather than serving as a direct marker of the plasma membrane itself. Therefore, it is the least representative of a plasma membrane enzymatic marker among the options provided.
